description.en: Continuous improvements to the core layout, theming and animation system based on real-world usage.

description.en: Added full multi-language support with locale routing, localized metadata and structured data.

description.en: Built the first version of the responsive layout, component library and animation system.

description.de: Erste Version des responsiven Layouts, der Komponentenbibliothek und des Animationssystems entwickelt.
